name: 华东师范大学
character: The historic campus features the famous Liwa River, grand early twentieth-century buildings from the former Great China University, and scenic spots with old trees, ponds, and greenery.

landmarks.name: 丽娃河
landmarks.quote: 校园内有上海著名的丽娃河（西班牙语：Rio Rita）
landmarks.look: A winding campus river with scenic banks, plain

landmarks.name: 思群堂
landmarks.quote: 现存大夏大学时期的主要建筑有：主教学楼群贤堂，大礼堂思群堂
landmarks.look: A grand historic auditorium building from the early twentieth century

landmarks.name: 群贤堂
landmarks.quote: 现存大夏大学时期的主要建筑有：主教学楼群贤堂，大礼堂思群堂
landmarks.look: A grand historic main teaching building, plain

landmarks.name: 办公楼
landmarks.quote: 2015年，华东师范大学办公楼和思群堂被列入上海市优秀历史建筑名单。
landmarks.look: An early historic university office building, plain

landmarks.name: 地理馆
landmarks.quote: 华东师范大学早期建筑（包括老干部活动中心、办公楼、地理馆和毛泽东像等）
landmarks.look: An early historic academic hall, plain

landmarks.name: 毛泽东像
landmarks.quote: 华东师范大学早期建筑（包括老干部活动中心、办公楼、地理馆和毛泽东像等）
landmarks.look: A standing statue of Mao Zedong on campus, plain

landmarks.name: 原生物实验楼
landmarks.quote: 现存大夏大学时期的主要建筑有：主教学楼群贤堂，大礼堂思群堂，原生物实验楼和化学实验楼等。
landmarks.look: A historic early twentieth-century laboratory building, plain
